GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

9. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

15. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
